title: DotfilesDevPorts
description: Structured ports object written into this repo and into every generated monorepo as config/ports.json. Schema property defaults fill missing keys. Intended runtime overrides use dotenv (.env gitignored, .env.example committed); generated Vite/Express do not load this file yet. Do not fall back to an example JSON file.

web.description: Host port published for the Vite frontend.

api.description: Host port published for the Express API.

bind.description: Host address for published ports. Default 127.0.0.1 (loopback only). Set BIND=0.0.0.0 in .env for LAN/homelab. Process listen inside a container is always 0.0.0.0; this field is the host publish address, not the container listen address.
